Hand-painted high-end children's animated film background with charming irregular shapes, crisp expressive silhouettes and subtle gouache texture, NOT photorealistic and NOT a UI mockup. Rescue infirmary nook with a paw medical sign on left, tiny colorful adoption cubbies and pet carriers on right, playful giant scratching tree, dog-eared care clipboard, food bowls, lush small plants and open arched gate to sunny green hills. No animals in this background, no people, no words, no text or watermarks. Composition designed for cropping on phones with all important structures in middle 75 percent. Endearing whimsical illustration, visually rich yet readable as a game environment. Output at highest available resolution.
